## 2018.03 Deprecated Packages
<a name="support-info-by-package-alami2018.03_release"></a>
+ Start Date: 2018-03-31
+ End Date:

 [https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/2018.03-release-notes/](https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/2018.03-release-notes/)

These packages were deprecated with the initial Amazon Linux 2018.03 release announcement and will not receive any further updates. Most were announced to be close to EOL in the 2016.09 release notes.

## EOL as of January 2020
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol202001"></a>
+ Start Date: 2020-01-20
+ End Date:

 [https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/](https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/)

 As announced with maintenance support, these packages will no longer receive updates. This matches their upstream EOL.

## Backwards Compatibility Packages
<a name="support-info-by-package-compat"></a>
+ Start Date:
+ End Date:

 [https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/](https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/)

 These packages are provided only for binary compatibility with older Amazon Linux versions. They do not receive security updates.

## MySQL 5.5 EOL was December 31, 2018

+ End Date:

 [https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/](https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/)

## PostgreSQL 9.4 upstream EOL was February 13, 2020
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_postgresql94"></a>
+ Start Date: 2020-02-13
+ End Date:

 [https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/](https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/)

Upstream PostgreSQL 9.4 reached EOL on February 13, 2020. As previously announced, AL1 is following the upstream EOL for PostgreSQL 9.4. The link provided is to the upstream statement.

## PHP 7.3 upstream EOL is December 6, 2021
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_php73-common"></a>
+ Start Date: 2021-12-06
+ End Date:

 [https://www.php.net/supported-versions](https://www.php.net/supported-versions)

## Python 3.6 upstream EOL is December 2021
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_python36"></a>
+ Start Date: 2021-12-31
+ End Date:

 [https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0494/](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0494/)

 The upstream Python community declared Python 3.6 EOL as December 23, 2021. As communicated previously, AL1 will follow the upstream EOL schedule for Python 3.6. The link provided is to the upstream Python 3.6 release schedule.

## Python 3.8 upstream EOL is after AL1 EOL
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol_python38"></a>
+ Start Date: 2024-10-14
+ End Date:

 [https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0494/](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0494/)

 The upstream Python community estimates an EOL date for Python 3.8 of October 14, 2024. Because this is after the AL1; EOL date, the earlier date of AL1 EOL applies.

## Amazon Linux 1 EOL
<a name="support-info-by-package-eol"></a>
+ Start Date: 2023-12-31
+ End Date:

 [https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/](https://aws.amazon.com/amazon-linux-ami/faqs/)

 The maintenance support period for AL1 ended on December 31st, 2023. From this point, the remaining AL1 packages (listed below) will no longer receive any updates from AWS.
